title: Mystical Teardrop Vessels
description: Three ornate teardrop-shaped objects with textured surfaces sit on a purple platform draped with rich fabrics. The largest one on the right features green and purple coloring with intricate golden thread patterns and dripping purple liquid, while a small glass ink bottle with blue liquid and yellow papers with drawings are placed in the foreground.
prompt: A surreal still life scene featuring three large ornate teardrop-shaped vessels on a draped purple platform, the largest one is vibrant green with purple accents wrapped in intricate golden threads and dripping thick purple liquid, a smaller green one with leaf-like patterns and a dark red one with blue threads, in the foreground a small glass ink bottle spilling blue liquid onto yellow papers with sketches, rich fabrics and dramatic purple and yellow lighting with dripping paint effects on the background wall, highly detailed textures, cinematic lighting
